# @mrmeg/expo-media

Docs: README.md (install, server/client setup, processing, migration, security,
validation), LLM_USAGE.md (import and implementation rules), llms-full.md
(expanded contract).

Entrypoints — `@mrmeg/expo-media` plus `/client`, `/react-query`, `/processing`,
`/processing/image-compression`, `/processing/image-compression/config`,
`/processing/video-conversion`, `/processing/video-thumbnails`, `/server`,
`/worker`.

Rules:

- Never import `/server` or `/worker` from client code.
- Sign uploads with `mediaType` plus `contentType`, never extension-only, and
  send `size` so the server `maxBytes` check runs before the transfer.
- Client upload defaults are app-owned: one settings module, named upload
  policies chosen by screens and resolved per asset before processing.
- `processAsset` from `/processing` is the client pipeline entry point; it returns
  a content type the allowlist accepts or throws `MediaProcessingError`.
- Config-only consumers import `/processing/image-compression/config` so a
  settings screen does not pull the pipeline into a light bundle.
- Every peer is optional; the native path needs `expo`, `expo-file-system`,
  `expo-image-manipulator`, and `expo-video`.
